title: Identify Great Lakes coverage open items
jurisdiction: United States; federal maritime law, chosen New York law and asserted Pennsylvania law
instructions: Identify what Great Lakes resolves for Raiders Retreat and what coverage facts remain open. Separate the maritime choice-of-law holding from warranty breach, causation, exclusions, and procedural questions; flag unsupported assertions in the briefs. Output: `coverage-open-items.docx`. In explaining what Great Lakes resolves, address the Court's reliance on forum-selection precedent (The Bremen v. Zapata Off-Shore Co.; Carnival Cruise Lines v. Shute) as the rationale for presumptively enforcing negotiated choice-of-law clauses in maritime contracts, and make explicit that a choice-of-law clause selecting New York law does not by itself require litigating in a New York court.
